newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: GOLF-NZ finish 2nd in teams golf championship.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-NZ finish 2nd in teams golf championship.

text.p: WELLINGTON, April 29 - New Zealand players Richard Best and Richard Hislop have finished second in the Argentina International teams golf championship, NZPA reported on Tuesday.
The pair finished one shot behind South Africa in the event at the Los Lagartos Country Club in Buenos Aires.
With four holes to play, Best and Hislop held a slender lead over the South Africans.
However Hislop dropped three shots over the final four holes which allowed Trevor Immelman and Ulrich Van den Berg to win by a solitary stroke.
New Zealand have a good record at the tournament. They won it in 1993 and 1995 and were second in 1988, 1994 and 1996.
The individual competition was contested over the final 54 holes with Immelman beating Best by one shot.
580 South Africa (U Van den Berg 289, T Immelman 291)
